arabic_text: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَهَى عَنْ بَيْعِ الْغَرَرِ
english_text: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited the sale involving uncertainty (gharar).

arabic_text: رُفِعَ الْقَلَمُ عَنْ ثَلَاثَةٍ عَنِ النَّائِمِ حَتَّى يَسْتَيْقِظَ وَعَنِ الصَّبِيِّ حَتَّى يَحْتَلِمَ وَعَنِ الْمَجْنُونِ حَتَّى يَعْقِلَ
english_text: The pen is lifted from three: the sleeper until he wakes, the child until he reaches puberty, and the insane until he regains his sanity.

arabic_text: إِذَا حَكَمَ الْحَاكِمُ فَاجْتَهَدَ ثُمَّ أَصَابَ فَلَهُ أَجْرَانِ وَإِذَا حَكَمَ فَاجْتَهَدَ ثُمَّ أَخْطَأَ فَلَهُ أَجْرٌ
english_text: If a judge makes a ruling and strives to reach the correct conclusion and gets it right, he has two rewards. If he strives and gets it wrong, he has one reward.

arabic_text: أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَسْجُدَ عَلَى سَبْعَةِ أَعْظُمٍ عَلَى الْجَبْهَةِ وَأَشَارَ بِيَدِهِ إِلَى أَنْفِهِ وَالْيَدَيْنِ وَالرُّكْبَتَيْنِ وَأَطْرَافِ الْقَدَمَيْنِ
english_text: I have been commanded to prostrate on seven bones: the forehead — and he pointed to his nose — the hands, the knees, and the tips of the feet.

arabic_text: لَا صَلَاةَ لِمَنْ لَمْ يَقْرَأْ بِفَاتِحَةِ الْكِتَابِ
english_text: There is no prayer for the one who does not recite the Opening of the Book (Al-Fatiha).

arabic_text: إِنَّ اللَّهَ تَجَاوَزَ عَنْ أُمَّتِي الْخَطَأَ وَالنِّسْيَانَ وَمَا اسْتُكْرِهُوا عَلَيْهِ
english_text: Allah has pardoned my ummah for mistakes, forgetfulness, and what they are coerced into doing.

arabic_text: الْبَيِّنَةُ عَلَى الْمُدَّعِي وَالْيَمِينُ عَلَى الْمُدَّعَى عَلَيْهِ
english_text: The burden of proof is upon the claimant, and the oath is upon the one who denies.

arabic_text: صَلُّوا كَمَا رَأَيْتُمُونِي أُصَلِّي
english_text: Pray as you have seen me praying.

arabic_text: خُذُوا عَنِّي مَنَاسِكَكُمْ
english_text: Take your rites of Hajj from me.

arabic_text: مَنْ أَحْدَثَ فِي أَمْرِنَا هَذَا مَا لَيْسَ مِنْهُ فَهُوَ رَدٌّ
english_text: Whoever introduces into this matter of ours something that is not part of it, it is rejected.

arabic_text: لَا وَصِيَّةَ لِوَارِثٍ
english_text: There is no bequest for an heir.

arabic_text: لَا يَرِثُ الْمُسْلِمُ الْكَافِرَ وَلَا الْكَافِرُ الْمُسْلِمَ
english_text: A Muslim does not inherit from a disbeliever, nor does a disbeliever inherit from a Muslim.

arabic_text: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَهَى عَنِ الْمُزَابَنَةِ وَالْمُحَاقَلَةِ
english_text: The Prophet ﷺ forbade muzabanah (selling fresh dates for dried dates by estimation) and muhaqalah (selling unharvested wheat for harvested wheat).

arabic_text: لَا تُنْكَحُ الْأَيِّمُ حَتَّى تُسْتَأْمَرَ وَلَا تُنْكَحُ الْبِكْرُ حَتَّى تُسْتَأْذَنَ
english_text: A previously married woman should not be married until she is consulted, and a virgin should not be married until her permission is sought.

arabic_text: لَا يَقْضِيَنَّ حَكَمٌ بَيْنَ اثْنَيْنِ وَهُوَ غَضْبَانُ
english_text: A judge should not pass judgment between two people while he is angry.

arabic_text: إِنَّ اللَّهَ فَرَضَ فَرَائِضَ فَلَا تُضَيِّعُوهَا وَحَدَّ حُدُودًا فَلَا تَعْتَدُوهَا وَحَرَّمَ أَشْيَاءَ فَلَا تَنْتَهِكُوهَا وَسَكَتَ عَنْ أَشْيَاءَ رَحْمَةً بِكُمْ غَيْرَ نِسْيَانٍ فَلَا تَسْأَلُوا عَنْهَا
english_text: Allah has made certain obligations, so do not neglect them. He has set limits, so do not transgress them. He has forbidden things, so do not violate them. And He has remained silent about things out of mercy, not forgetfulness, so do not ask about them.

arabic_text: الْخَرَاجُ بِالضَّمَانِ
english_text: Revenue comes with liability (profit is linked to risk).

arabic_text: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَضَى بِالشُّفْعَةِ فِي كُلِّ مَا لَمْ يُقْسَمْ
english_text: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ ruled that pre-emption (shuf'ah) applies to every undivided jointly-owned property.

arabic_text: مَطْلُ الْغَنِيِّ ظُلْمٌ
english_text: The delay of payment by a wealthy person is injustice.

arabic_text: مَنِ اقْتَطَعَ حَقَّ امْرِئٍ مُسْلِمٍ بِيَمِينِهِ فَقَدْ أَوْجَبَ اللَّهُ لَهُ النَّارَ وَحَرَّمَ عَلَيْهِ الْجَنَّةَ
english_text: Whoever seizes the right of a Muslim by a false oath, Allah will decree the Fire for him and forbid him Paradise.

arabic_text: إِنَّ أَعْظَمَ الْفِرْيَةِ أَنْ يَدَّعِيَ الرَّجُلُ إِلَى غَيْرِ أَبِيهِ
english_text: Indeed, the gravest falsehood is for a man to claim descent from someone other than his father.

arabic_text: نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْ بَيْعِ الثَّمَرَةِ حَتَّى يَبْدُوَ صَلَاحُهَا
english_text: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade selling fruit until its ripeness becomes apparent.

arabic_text: لَعَنَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ آكِلَ الرِّبَا وَمُوكِلَهُ وَكَاتِبَهُ وَشَاهِدَيْهِ
english_text: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ cursed the one who consumes riba (interest), the one who pays it, the one who writes it, and the two witnesses to it.

arabic_text: إِنَّ الدِّينَ يُسْرٌ وَلَنْ يُشَادَّ الدِّينَ أَحَدٌ إِلَّا غَلَبَهُ
english_text: Indeed, this religion is easy, and no one overburdens himself in religion except that it overwhelms him.

arabic_text: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَهَى عَنْ بَيْعَتَيْنِ فِي بَيْعَةٍ
english_text: The Prophet ﷺ prohibited two transactions in one transaction.

arabic_text: أَيُّمَا امْرَأَةٍ نَكَحَتْ بِغَيْرِ إِذْنِ وَلِيِّهَا فَنِكَاحُهَا بَاطِلٌ
english_text: Any woman who marries without the permission of her guardian, her marriage is invalid.

arabic_text: لَا نِكَاحَ إِلَّا بِوَلِيٍّ
english_text: There is no marriage except with a guardian.

arabic_text: مَنْ أَعْتَقَ شِرْكًا لَهُ فِي عَبْدٍ فَكَانَ لَهُ مَالٌ يَبْلُغُ ثَمَنَ الْعَبْدِ قُوِّمَ الْعَبْدُ عَلَيْهِ قِيمَةَ عَدْلٍ فَأَعْطَى شُرَكَاءَهُ حِصَصَهُمْ وَعَتَقَ عَلَيْهِ
english_text: Whoever frees his share of a jointly-owned slave and has enough money, the slave's fair value is assessed. He pays the co-owners their shares, and the slave is freed.

arabic_text: لَا يُجْمَعُ بَيْنَ الْمَرْأَةِ وَعَمَّتِهَا وَلَا بَيْنَ الْمَرْأَةِ وَخَالَتِهَا
english_text: A woman should not be married simultaneously with her paternal aunt or her maternal aunt.

arabic_text: الذَّهَبُ بِالذَّهَبِ وَالْفِضَّةُ بِالْفِضَّةِ وَالْبُرُّ بِالْبُرِّ وَالشَّعِيرُ بِالشَّعِيرِ وَالتَّمْرُ بِالتَّمْرِ وَالْمِلْحُ بِالْمِلْحِ مِثْلًا بِمِثْلٍ سَوَاءً بِسَوَاءٍ يَدًا بِيَدٍ
english_text: Gold for gold, silver for silver, wheat for wheat, barley for barley, dates for dates, salt for salt — like for like, equal for equal, hand to hand.

arabic_text: لَا يَبِيعُ حَاضِرٌ لِبَادٍ
english_text: A resident should not sell on behalf of a desert-dweller (a settled middleman should not exploit the ignorance of newcomers).

arabic_text: نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنِ النَّجْشِ
english_text: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade najash (artificially inflating prices through fake bidding).

arabic_text: لَا تَلَقَّوُا الرُّكْبَانَ وَلَا يَبِعْ بَعْضُكُمْ عَلَى بَيْعِ بَعْضٍ
english_text: Do not go out to meet the riders (to buy their goods before they reach the market), and do not sell over the sale of one another.

arabic_text: مَنْ أَسْلَمَ عَلَى شَيْءٍ فَهُوَ لَهُ
english_text: Whoever accepts Islam while possessing something, it remains his.

arabic_text: لَا يَحِلُّ مَالُ امْرِئٍ مُسْلِمٍ إِلَّا بِطِيبِ نَفْسٍ مِنْهُ
english_text: It is not permissible to take the wealth of a Muslim except with his willing consent.

arabic_text: فِي الرِّكَازِ الْخُمُسُ
english_text: In buried treasure (rikaz), one-fifth (is due as zakat).

arabic_text: لَيْسَ فِيمَا دُونَ خَمْسِ أَوَاقٍ صَدَقَةٌ وَلَيْسَ فِيمَا دُونَ خَمْسِ ذَوْدٍ صَدَقَةٌ وَلَيْسَ فِيمَا دُونَ خَمْسَةِ أَوْسُقٍ صَدَقَةٌ
english_text: There is no zakat on less than five awaq of silver, nor on less than five camels, nor on less than five wasq of grain.

arabic_text: تُعْرَضُ الْفِتَنُ عَلَى الْقُلُوبِ كَالْحَصِيرِ عُودًا عُودًا فَأَيُّ قَلْبٍ أُشْرِبَهَا نُكِتَ فِيهِ نُكْتَةٌ سَوْدَاءُ
english_text: Trials are presented to the hearts like a reed mat, woven stick by stick. Any heart that absorbs them gets a black spot imprinted on it.

arabic_text: عَلَيْكُمْ بِسُنَّتِي وَسُنَّةِ الْخُلَفَاءِ الرَّاشِدِينَ الْمَهْدِيِّينَ عَضُّوا عَلَيْهَا بِالنَّوَاجِذِ
english_text: Hold fast to my Sunnah and the way of the rightly-guided caliphs. Bite onto it with your molars.

arabic_text: مَا تَرَكْتُ بَعْدِي فِتْنَةً أَضَرَّ عَلَى الرِّجَالِ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ
english_text: I have not left behind me a trial more harmful to men than women.

arabic_text: يَتَقَارَبُ الزَّمَانُ وَيَنْقُصُ الْعِلْمُ وَتَظْهَرُ الْفِتَنُ وَيُلْقَى الشُّحُّ وَيَكْثُرُ الْهَرْجُ
english_text: Time will pass rapidly, knowledge will decrease, trials will appear, miserliness will spread, and killing will increase.

arabic_text: لَا تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ حَتَّى يُقْبَضَ الْعِلْمُ وَتَكْثُرَ الزَّلَازِلُ وَيَتَقَارَبَ الزَّمَانُ
english_text: The Hour will not come until knowledge is taken away, earthquakes increase, and time passes quickly.

arabic_text: لَا تَزَالُ طَائِفَةٌ مِنْ أُمَّتِي ظَاهِرِينَ عَلَى الْحَقِّ لَا يَضُرُّهُمْ مَنْ خَذَلَهُمْ حَتَّى يَأْتِيَ أَمْرُ اللَّهِ
english_text: There will always remain a group from my ummah manifest upon the truth. They will not be harmed by those who forsake them until the command of Allah comes.

arabic_text: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَهَى عَنْ كُلِّ ذِي نَابٍ مِنَ السِّبَاعِ وَعَنْ كُلِّ ذِي مِخْلَبٍ مِنَ الطَّيْرِ
english_text: The Prophet ﷺ forbade eating every predatory animal with fangs and every bird with talons.

arabic_text: إِنَّ أَوَّلَ مَا يُحَاسَبُ بِهِ الْعَبْدُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مِنْ عَمَلِهِ صَلَاتُهُ
english_text: The first thing a servant will be held accountable for on the Day of Judgment from his deeds is his prayer.

arabic_text: إِذَا اجْتَهَدَ الْحَاكِمُ فَأَخْطَأَ فَلَهُ أَجْرٌ وَإِذَا اجْتَهَدَ فَأَصَابَ فَلَهُ أَجْرَانِ
english_text: When a judge strives and makes an error, he gets one reward. When he strives and is correct, he gets two rewards.

arabic_text: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ رَجَمَ مَاعِزًا وَالْغَامِدِيَّةَ
english_text: The Prophet ﷺ carried out the legal punishment on Ma'iz and the Ghamidiyyah (after their own confessions and insistence).

arabic_text: ادْرَءُوا الْحُدُودَ عَنِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُمْ فَإِنْ كَانَ لَهُ مَخْرَجٌ فَخَلُّوا سَبِيلَهُ
english_text: Avert legal punishments from Muslims as much as possible. If there is a way out for him, let him go.

arabic_text: لَا يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يَكُونَ هَوَاهُ تَبَعًا لِمَا جِئْتُ بِهِ
english_text: None of you truly believes until his desires are in accordance with what I have brought.

arabic_text: لَا تَجْتَمِعُ أُمَّتِي عَلَى ضَلَالَةٍ
english_text: My ummah will not unite upon misguidance.
